issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - General 5,469.99, Street 82.00, Cemetery 1,600.00, Perpetual care 50.00, Recreation 9,058.00, Sales tax 1,687.28
issues.issue: Half of the 17,947.27 is in the Recreation fund column (9,058, probably recreation fees) and 1,600 is in the Cemetery fund column (probably cemetery fees). The printed label says Other and nothing on the page names the receipts, so 'other' is defensible.

The line is printed under the governmental heading 'Community Development' but only in the Water fund column. Recording it as business-type utilities is an assumption (the extractor added a review note).
